headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: LEC (4)

summary: Max Verstappen won the Las Vegas Grand Prix from P2 on the grid, 23.5s ahead of George Russell, with Kimi Antonelli completing the podium.
Kimi Antonelli made the biggest climb, from P17 to P3.
Liam Lawson had a day to forget, dropping from P6 to P14.
The race was neutralised by 2 virtual safety cars.
The stewards penalised ANT (5 second time penalty), ALB (5 second time penalty) and ALB (reprimand).
There were 23 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Lando Norris leads the championship by 30 points over Oscar Piastri.
